GATHER YOUR CLASSMATES AND WIN ₱10,000!

Aurora MLBB invites everyone to the XCC Philippines Grand Finals on June 28, 12PM, at Ayala Malls Market! Market!. Rally your squad because the top two collegiate esports organizations with the highest participant count will each take home ₱10,000! 🏆 But the excitement doesn’t end there two lucky attendees will also have a chance to win amazing prizes, including a TTRacing gaming chair and an Infinix GT30 Pro. 

It’s game time for NU Bulldogs and DLSU Green Aces. Don’t miss this epic showdown!

#XCC2025 #InfinixCampusCup #WhereLegendsRise #InfinixGT30Pro #MLBBEsports
